title: Valid Palindrome
statement_short: Given a string s, determine if it is a palindrome after converting all uppercase letters into lowercase letters and removing all non-alphanumeric characters. Read forwards and backwards identically.
constraints: 1 <= s.length <= 2 \* 10^5, s consists only of printable ASCII characters
hint: String length up to 2 \* 10^5 mandates an O(n) time solution, achieved by inward scanning pointers.
why_not: Right: Two Pointers compare valid alphanumeric characters inward from opposite string ends in O(n) time and O(1) space. Not Stack: Pushing valid characters onto a stack reverses the string but uses O(n) extra space. Not Sliding Window: Palindrome checking evaluates boundary characters moving inward rather than maintaining a fixed subsegment. Not HashMap / Hash Set: Character frequency tables verify anagrams, not palindrome character ordering.
